annotations.text:
The site shell is unchanged — same masthead, footer, ground and IBM Plex. Only the accent changes inside /rhythm: the app's own teal (#2FA98B) instead of the site amber.

Type follows Rhythm's docs/wordmark-and-type.md §3, the scale that document defines for exactly this case: display 56/500/-3.5%, heading 22/500/-2%, body 17/400/1.6, mono labels 11 uppercase +0.16em.

Every claim is drawn from docs/store-listing.md §2, which is asserted by StoreListingTests. Nothing here makes a claim its §6 refuses.

The App Store button is inert — outlined and grey, not a link — with a filled teal Coming soon chip beside it. One constant at the top of the page turns it into a real button.

Every capture is of the app itself: iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape, light and dark.

The bar sheet and the song are your two device screenshots. The bar one is store-listing.md §7's missing row 3 — it cannot be rendered by the harness. The song's iOS status bar was cropped so it matches the other captures, none of which have one.

Written against docs/privacy-audit.md §2, §3 and §5 rather than from a template, so every sentence is one the audit already evidences.

No iCloud sync claim — FR-1004 does not exist in v1, and store-listing.md §6 refuses it. What IS true is the system device backup, and it says so.

This address replaces PrivacyPolicy.privacyPolicyAddress in AboutScreen.swift, which is still on the .invalid placeholder.
